name: Arcana
summary: Knowledge of spells, magic items, and planar lore.
description: Your Intelligence (Arcana) check measures your ability to recall lore about spells, magic items, eldritch symbols, magical traditions, the planes of existence, and the inhabitants of those planes.
typicalUses: Identify magic traditions, planar signs, occult symbols.
exampleChecks: Recognize a ritual circle; recall a magic item's school; identify an aberration's nature.
